title: Isandro and the Thorn
author: Casper Sterling
blurb: Wendell Almeida, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
